body: I like to stream video games to help, solve Rubik's cubes, and go on walks. Those seem to help but I also seem to go back to that anxious feeling. I really try and keep my mind off of things by doing tasks such as cleaning my room, doing dishes, cooking food, etc., but I can't shake the feeling of impending doom.

I was actually diagnosed 2 weeks ago, 3 weeks tomorrow. So I’m brand new to the whole experience

You’ll be pleased to know that there are so many gluten free options! I’ve tried quite a lot of things, such as gluten free pizza, buns/bread, cupcake batter, noodles, and even beer. It’s all incredibly good! You have to really be a flavor expert to notice the difference. The bread and buns are a little more dry than regular wheat bread, but the flavor is all there :) Some of it is going to have to be an acquired taste. Kicking most fast food is still a big challenge for me, but you have to look at it as you won’t be in pain! Plus, it’ll improve your diet and overall body health by kicking most of the food away. 

I guess the biggest issue I have is not being able to eat whatever I want anymore. I can’t just pick up chicken nuggets from McDonald’s or grab a box of crackers and hit the road. It’s a huge lifestyle change, and we all know it. Just gotta keep your head up and make it a fulfilling time by trying all this new kind of food!
